reasoning: For Alençon, France in mid-to-late March, temperatures are generally warming as spring progresses. March 22 is one week after March 15, so climatologically we'd expect slightly warmer average temperatures on the later date. However, daily weather variability is substantial - day-to-day temperature swings of several degrees are common due to weather systems. The week-apart comparison means the seasonal warming trend (~0.2-0.3°C per week in March) provides only a slight edge for the later date. Given high daily variability, the probability is close to 50% but slightly favoring the later date being warmer.
